conflicts.description: The advisory states the exposure as between 18:42 and 20:31 UTC at minute precision without seconds or explicit inclusivity. A second-resolution end boundary of 20:31:00 would exclude runs inside the stated final minute; a boundary of 20:31:59 would invent seconds. The incident issue repeats the same minute-level period.
conflicts.rationale: The window end is encoded as the exclusive next-minute boundary 20:32:00 with approximation source-rounded and the original claim retained verbatim, so every instant inside the stated final minute is covered and the source's minute precision is preserved.

The resolved commit 3f401fe1d58fe77e10d665ab713057375e39b887 is the v1.3.0 release commit from 2024-03-12, so the retag restored a pre-existing object rather than publishing a reviewed fix; its content and tag history have not been independently reviewed.
conflicts.rationale: No known-good identity is encoded. A run that resolved the restored object therefore remains a mutable-ref or current-reference finding rather than a confirmed no-match until reviewers independently verify the object.
